summary.name: Dropbox
summary.one_liner: Dropbox is a cloud storage and file-sharing service with synced team folders, file previews, and integrations with AI assistants.
use_cases: connect cloud files to AI assistants
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Dropbox as cloud storage with synced team folders that keep file versions current. It offers previews for 175+ file types and says built-in AI summaries are coming soon. It supports real-time syncing and large file transfers of up to 250GB. The page also lists integrations that let AI tools such as ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Microsoft Copilot and others reference Dropbox content and save work back to it. The page does not state pricing details.
notable: AI integrations with ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot and others
caveats: Built-in AI summaries are listed as coming soon
The awesome-mac listing describes it as freeware, but the page itself does not state pricing
